atoms.b: Urban areas have a lot of ((fields ++buildings)) that are tightly packed together, so only a small percentage of the Earth’s total land is used for them.

instruction.text: What percentage of the Earth’s land do you think is used for urban areas?

feedback.end: Even though only 3% of the Earth’s land is used for urban areas, 58% of the human population live in them!

atoms.b: The places where people live are called residential areas. They are often on the ((++outskirts inskirts)) of cities in areas called suburbs.

instruction.text: Draw a line to connect the road between the suburbs and the city centre.

atoms.b: Land is used for roads and rail networks, which transport lots of people from the suburbs into the city centre to ((++work sleep)).
These people work in hundreds of different types of businesses in urban areas, such as ((++shops shoes)) and banks.
People may also work in industrial areas, such as ((++factories rivers)) and warehouses. These are usually found at the edge of cities, where there is more space.

feedback.end: Recreational areas are another common use of urban land. These include things like parks and sports stadiums.
